apartments.description: Welcome to 1077 Ashbury Apartments, a beautiful apartment in the peaceful Haight Ashbury neighborhood. This pet-friendly, smoke-free apartment offers the perfect mix of historical charm and modern design. Inside, you'll find a spacious living area with beautiful flooring and large windows that let in tons of natural light. The sleek kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances and plenty of counter space, making cooking a pleasure. Outside, you can relax in the garden space or enjoy the fresh air in the common area. The property is close to everything you need, from the Haight-Ashbury district with its cafes and shops to the peaceful Buena Vista Park. Getting around is a breeze with public transportation nearby. With amenities like trash/recycling/compost services, an online payment portal, and resident support, this apartment makes life easy and comfortable.

apartments.description: Welcome to 1040 Ashbury Apartments, a pet-friendly, smoke-free apartment situated in San Francisco's highly sought-after Buena Vista neighborhood. This well-maintained building combines historic character with modern conveniences, including gated entry, intercom access, and security cameras for your peace of mind. Residents enjoy a range of amenities such as a courtyard, shared common backyard, and garden space, perfect for relaxation or social gatherings. Inside, the efficient kitchen appliances and spacious living areas make this home both functional and comfortable. Other convenient features include common area laundry, online payment portal, maintenance support, and resident services. Eco-friendly services like trash, recycling, and compost ensure a sustainable lifestyle. Zazie, a beloved French bistro, Coffee to the People, and the unique shops along Haight Apartments are just a short walk away, while the iconic Golden Gate Park and Buena Vista Park offer a wealth of outdoor activities. Public transportation is easily accessible, making commuting and exploring the city a breeze. This property is the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.

apartments.description: Welcome to 800 Duboce Apartments, a pet-friendly, smoke-free community in San Francisco's Buena Vista neighborhood. Designed for urban convenience, this well-maintained building offers secure access with intercom entry, security cameras, and a welcoming lobby. Residents benefit from bike storage, a common area lounge, landscaped courtyard and garden space, and a shared laundry facility. Each apartment features large windows that invite natural light, efficient kitchen appliances, and a thoughtfully designed layout. The location is unmatched, with Safeway, Whole Foods, and essential services nearby, plus easy access to the N Judah Muni line for seamless commuting. Enjoy outdoor escapes at Buena Vista Park, cultural experiences at the Randall Museum, and popular dining spots like Duboce Park Cafe and L'Ardoise Bistro. apartments.description: 1755 Van Ness, known collectively with its neighboring buildings as the \"Three Sisters,\" was built in 1928 and offers beautiful Spanish Colonial and neo-gothic architectural detail throughout. Many of its apartments feature classic bay windows, sweeping views, and an abundance of natural light, complemented by original hardwood floors and thoughtfully updated kitchens and bathrooms, blending vintage charm with modern comfort.Ideally situated along the Van Ness corridor in Pacific Heights, residents enjoy easy access to the best of San Francisco living. Polk Street's boutiques, wine bars, and neighborhood restaurants are just around the corner, while Lafayette Park, Trader Joe's, and Whole Foods are all within a short walk. The Marina, Russian Hill, and Cow Hollow are easily reachable on foot, and with MUNI bus lines right at your doorstep, the rest of the city is never far behind.

apartments.description: 1735 Van Ness, affectionately known as the Spreckels Mansion and the centerpiece of the \"Three Sisters,\" carries some fascinating history. The original estate on this corner belonged to Claus Spreckels, one of San Francisco's most powerful sugar barons of the Gilded Age, whose grand mansion was lost in the devastating 1906 earthquake and fire. In its place rose the stunning apartment building that stands today, built in 1928 and designed with the same spirit of grandeur. The lobby, dressed in Spanish Colonial style with a wooden ceiling clad in gold copper leaf, is a testament to that legacy, and many apartments throughout carry the character of the era, with magnificent neo-gothic architectural details, original hardwood floors, bay windows, big views and updated kitchens and bathrooms.Ideally situated along the Van Ness corridor in Pacific Heights, residents enjoy easy access to the best of San Francisco living. Polk Street's boutiques, wine bars, and neighborhood restaurants are just around the corner, while Lafayette Park, Trader Joe's, and Whole Foods are all within a short walk. The Marina, Russian Hill, and Cow Hollow are easily reachable on foot, and with MUNI bus lines right at your doorstep, the rest of the city is never far behind.

apartments.description: 1935 Jefferson Apartments offers beautifully appointed homes in one of San Francisco's most sought-after addresses. Many units feature thoughtfully upgraded kitchens and bathrooms, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, making everyday living feel effortless. With secure intercom entry and a pet-friendly environment, this is a building designed around the way people actually live.Nestled in the heart of the Marina District, 1935 Jefferson places you steps from the iconic Palace of Fine Arts and the waterfront paths of Marina Green. Chestnut Street's celebrated dining and boutique shopping are right outside your door, and the bay is never far from view. This is San Francisco living at its most effortless, where the neighborhood itself becomes part of your daily life.

Gated entry and intercom access offer peace of mind, while on-site laundry and dedicated maintenance keep daily life running smoothly. UC Berkeley is easily accessible, and Telegraph Avenue's cafes and restaurants are right in the mix. When you need to get further, Downtown Berkeley BART puts the entire Bay Area within easy reach. For those who want a polished Berkeley home without compromise, 2252 Parker delivers.

apartments.description: Just minutes from UC Berkeley, 2520 College Avenue stands out for both its location and its amenities. Every unit comes with one dedicated parking space at no extra cost -- a rare find in Berkeley -- and residents have access to a pool, courtyard, shared backyard with BBQ, common lounge, and bike storage, making it easy to decompress after a long day. Day-to-day living is kept simple with in-unit washer/dryer in select homes, common area laundry, and on-site trash, recycling, and compost services. Whole Foods, Berkeley Bowl, and some of Berkeley's best dining -- including La Mediterranee and Sliver Pizzeria -- are all within easy reach, and Downtown Berkeley BART keeps the rest of the Bay accessible.

apartments.description: Steps from UC Berkeley's south gate, 2500 Durant Avenue puts you at the center of everything the Southside has to offer. Select updated units bring a fresh, modern feel to the space, while gated entry, security cameras, and common area laundry keep day-to-day living secure and convenient. Trash, recycling, and compost services are all handled on-site, and a community notice board keeps residents in the loop. The building is surrounded by some of Berkeley's best -- grab a slice at Sliver Pizzeria, sit down for a meal at La Mediterranee, or stock up at Whole Foods or Berkeley Bowl, all within easy walking distance. Downtown Berkeley BART is just around the corner, making the rest of the Bay just as accessible as everything on your block.

apartments.description: Steps from UC Berkeley's south gate, 2500 Durant Avenue puts you at the center of everything the Southside has to offer. Select updated units bring a fresh, modern feel to the space, while gated entry, security cameras, and common area laundry keep day-to-day living secure and convenient. Trash, recycling, and compost services are all handled on-site, and a community notice board keeps residents in the loop. The building is surrounded by some of Berkeley's best -- grab a slice at Sliver Pizzeria, sit down for a meal at La Mediterranee, or stock up at Whole Foods or Berkeley Bowl, all within easy walking distance. Downtown Berkeley BART is just around the corner, making the rest of the Bay just as accessible as everything on your block.

apartments.description: Nestled in one of Berkeley's most peaceful residential neighborhoods, 2363 Le Conte Avenue offers generously sized, light-filled units that feel a world away from the bustle of the city. A shared backyard with lush common area plants gives residents a quiet outdoor escape right at home. Tucked near the Euclid Corridor, the neighborhood's cafes and restaurants are right around the corner, UC Berkeley is easily accessible, and Downtown Berkeley BART connects you to the rest of the Bay without any hassle. Gated entry, on-site laundry, storage, and dedicated parking round out the essentials. 2363 Le Conte is Berkeley at its most livable.

apartments.description: Located on the Northside just steps from UC Berkeley, 1771 Highland Place offers updated homes with thoughtful details -- select units feature private balconies, patios, or in-unit washer/dryer. The building's rooftop common area is a standout, with sweeping views of Berkeley and the surrounding hills. Residents enjoy one assigned parking space included with every apartment, plus gated entry, an elevator, bike storage, and a shared courtyard with BBQ. The Gourmet Ghetto and Euclid corridor are right around the corner, with BART easily accessible for getting into the city.
